chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 140: Ji Ning Rescues the Meng Clan on the Road to Anchan City
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning saves three Zifu Disciples from a deadly ambush on the road to Anchan City, learning about the politics of powerful clans and the harsh reality of the cultivation world.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 140: Ji Ning's Efficient Rescue
og_description: A tense ambush ends before it begins as Ji Ning's hidden flying sword takes out two Snowdragon Mountain thugs. But the real story is the politics of the Meng clan.
twitter_description: Ji Ning makes quick work of some bandits and picks up three new travel companions from the oppressed Meng clan. Anchan City is in sight!
